question: Pudukkottai Dakshinamoorthy Pillai is a renowned _________ player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanjira**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pudukkotai Dakshinamurthi Pillai is renowned for his exceptional skills in playing the Kanjira.
 
• The** Kanjira is a South Indian frame drum** and is an essential component of Carnatic music percussion ensembles.
 
• Pudukkotai Dakshinamurthi Pillai **was a pioneer in popularizing the Kanjira and contributed significantly to its prominence in classical music.**
 
• His techniques and performances set a high standard and have inspired many subsequent generations of musicians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
